trust.offline: Works offline after the first load

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Grant local webcam access. Your camera feed stays strictly in your browser.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Raise your hand 1 to 2 feet in front of your camera in normal room lighting.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Flick left or right, hold an open palm to pause, or point to guide the virtual cursor.

modes.title: Control Modes Hub
modes.subtitle: Choose a dedicated touchless workspace tailored for your workflow.
modes.presentationDesc: Swipe left and right to navigate slides with touchless pause.
modes.mediaDesc: Play, pause, adjust volume, and capture snapshots with hand signs.
modes.scrollDesc: Hands-free continuous auto-scrolling for articles and documents.
modes.cursorDesc: Direct fingertip pointer tracking with 1.5s dwell auto-clicking.
modes.kitchenDesc: Follow recipes and control kitchen timers without touching dirty screens.
modes.practiceDesc: Train your spatial precision with an interactive balloon popping game.

media.title: Synthesized Media Theater
media.guide: Closed Fist (Play) • Open Palm (Pause) • Thumb Up/Down (Volume) • Victory (Snapshot)
media.enableSoundBanner: Click once to enable sound, then use gestures.

settings.title: Engine & Accessibility Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize action mappings, accessibility accommodations, and low-end hardware modes.
settings.accessibilityDesc: Enhanced contrast, slower gesture thresholds (500ms), dwell click, and readable typography.
settings.lowEndDesc: Lowers webcam resolution (320x240) and limits target FPS (15-20) to save battery.

auth.passMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters

profile.title: User Profile & Data
profile.subtitle: Manage your credentials, offline IndexedDB telemetry, and data privacy.
profile.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account and all local IndexedDB records? This action cannot be undone.

practice.title: Spatial Precision Practice
practice.subtitle: Pop targets with fingertip tracking to calibrate your spatial gestures.

analytics.title: Gesture Telemetry & Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Live performance metrics stored locally in IndexedDB.
